sentences.text:
Author: K. Sreenivasa Reddy
Bench: K. Sreenivasa Reddy
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice K. Sreenivasa Reddy
 Criminal Petition No.6632 of 2023
Order:

This Criminal Petition, under Section 482 Cr.P.C., has been
filed on behalf of the Petitioners/A-1 and A-2, to quash the proceedings
in Sc No.188 of 2021 on the file of the learned Senior Civil Judge-cum-
Assistant Sessions Judge, Gooty, registered for the offences punishable
under Sections 270, 273, 328 read with 34 Ipc and Section 59(i) of the
Food Safety Standards Act, 2006.

2. Today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, it is submitted
by the learned counsel for the petitioners, and admitted to, by the
learned Assistant Public Prosecutor, that the subject matter of this
Criminal Petition is squarely covered by the common order passed by
this Court in Criminal Petition No.2966 of 2021 and batch, dated
28.12.2021, wherein this Court held thus.

"Criminal Petition Nos.3555, 3671, 3725, 4062 and  4064 of 2021 are partly allowed quashing the FIRs  (shown in Table-III) registered for the offences  punishable under the provisions of the IPC, FSS Act and  COPTA alone.

The Investigating officers shall proceed  with the investigation in relation to the offences  punishable under the provisions of NDPS Act relating to  the FIRs shown in Table-III."
 2 3.

Hence, following the said order passed by this Court in Criminal Muppagowni Narasimhudu vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 4 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186997376/
1 Petition No.2966 of 2021 and batch, dated 28.12.2021, and for the reasons mentioned therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed quashing the proceedings in SC No.188 of 2021 on the file of the learned Senior Civil Judge-cum-Assistant Sessions Judge, Gooty, against the petitioners herein/A-1 and A-2 for the offences punishable under the provisions of the IPC and FSS Act.
